native.cooperative_stop_command: stop followed by LF or CRLF; fixed six-byte reader

browser.close_observation: close actual local Chrome tab through cua and record its observed tab ID

measurements.native_complete_call_ms: Monotonic wall duration includes Metal setup/compile/compute/readback verification
measurements.raf_interval_ms: Animation callback interval; first sample is null; not presented-frame timing
measurements.queue_completion_wall_ms: Host-observed submit to queue completion; not GPU hardware timestamp
measurements.native_rss_bytes: Actual same-PID ps RSS sampled every 200 ms
measurements.browser_js_heap_estimate_bytes: Browser performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize when available; null otherwise
measurements.percentiles: Nearest-rank p50/p95/p99, min/max/mean; raw samples retained
